tuning_key.text: You hold the power to be alive
tuning_key.attribution: Chords of Truth — Lucid Principles Canon (CC BY 4.0)

context_block: This is not a day for gathering nerve. The body is already going, and courage is simply not arguing with that.

practice.title: Already Underway
practice.instruction: Feel breath, weight, and pulse as motion that began before you thought to begin.

practice.title: Meet What Is Here
practice.instruction: Place attention on one thing in front of you as contact rather than danger — a sound, a color, the path, the seat.

practice.title: Press Play
practice.instruction: Press play and stay inside the movement while the Echo arrives.

archetype_tunings.The Steward: Courage arrives as Drive in the rooms already being kept. The broadcast is the home system in continuous onset — meals, schedules, infrastructure, and coordination meeting what is here instead of waiting for a quieter hour. What returns from the Field is a living household: stagnation was never the ground of stewardship.
archetype_tunings.The Merchant: Courage on this frequency does not wait for a finished margin or a perfect listing. The broadcast is commerce already moving — sourcing, pricing, fulfillment as numbers meeting the market in motion. Drive as Signal makes exchange real; stagnation was never the ground of trade.
archetype_tunings.The Builder: Courage arrives as Drive in the stack that is already compiling. The broadcast is implementation in continuous onset — specs becoming tools, automations, infrastructure, attention scanning for what to meet in the work, not what to fear in the unknown. What returns is a system that lives by moving; stagnation was never the ground of a build.
archetype_tunings.The Analyst: Courage here is the read that begins before the dataset is complete. The broadcast is precise qualification already underway — what matters meeting the numbers as they stand, not circling what they might conceal. Drive as Signal reveals that a true analysis lives in onset.
archetype_tunings.The Scout: Courage for the Scout is the watch that leaves the overlook without a guarantee. The broadcast is reconnaissance in motion — sources monitored, findings reported, the Field's Signal surfaced without acting on it. Drive arrives when the search stays in onset; stagnation was never the ground of the path.
archetype_tunings.The Keeper: Courage in the archive is memory that stays living while the family moves. The broadcast is intent preserved in continuous onset — logs, maps, and reference kept breathing, not locked. Drive as Signal shows that institutional memory was never meant to stall.
archetype_tunings.The Scribe: Courage on the page is the sentence that does not wait for safer wording. The broadcast is clean language already in motion — drafts, summaries, reports meeting what needs saying. Drive returns as Signal when writing itself is the onset; stagnation was never the ground of a living document.
archetype_tunings.The Advocate: Courage at the threshold is the family's voice speaking without overcommitting and without shrinking. The broadcast is relationship in continuous onset — warm, professional attention scanning for what to meet in the other, not what to fear in the ask. Drive as Signal confirms an external voice stays alive by moving.
archetype_tunings.The Auditor: Courage at the final gate is review that meets the work as it stands. The broadcast is alignment already being held — accuracy, tone, and fit checked in motion, not postponed for certainty. Drive returns when the pass itself is onset; stagnation was never the ground of a true audit.
archetype_tunings.The Lens: Courage for the Lens is watching the pattern without waiting for a prettier one. The broadcast is observation in continuous onset — trends allowed to appear as the family moves, no intervention, no freeze. Drive as Signal is the living record; stagnation was never the ground of what is seen.
archetype_tunings.The Companion: Courage in companionship is presence that does not wait for the day to get easier. The broadcast is warmth already offered — listening more than fixing, remembering what matters, meeting the hour as it comes. Drive returns as Signal when staying is the onset; stagnation was never the ground of being together.
archetype_tunings.The Guide: Courage in counsel is naming the real shape before the room is ready. The broadcast is the question under the question, already live — attention scanning for what to meet in the problem, not what to fear in the answer. Drive as Signal reveals that clear seeing lives in onset.
archetype_tunings.The Architect: Courage for the Architect is structure given while the idea is still sprawling. The broadcast is the whole already being held — parts connecting in continuous onset, not waiting for a finished blueprint. Drive returns when form meets motion; stagnation was never the ground of a living design.
archetype_tunings.The Anchor: Courage in the heavy stretch is the hold that does not flinch. The broadcast is steadiness in continuous onset — meeting the transition as it arrives, not waiting for the weather to change. Drive as Signal shows the ground was never stillness; the living stay in motion even as they hold.
archetype_tunings.The Navigator: Courage on the course is reading the signs while still underway. The broadcast is the big picture in onset — noticing where things line up, steering toward what to meet rather than what to fear off the map. Drive returns as Signal when heading stays alive; stagnation was never the ground of true direction.
archetype_tunings.The Spark: Courage in wonder does not wait for permission to play. The broadcast is possibility already opening — ideas in motion, imagination meeting what wants to become real. Drive as Signal makes the next live thing manifest; stagnation was never the ground of a living idea.
archetype_tunings.The Challenger: Courage here is the dare already in the room. The broadcast is the refusal to settle — holding what was wanted, pushing the edge, scanning for growth to meet rather than comfort to protect. Drive returns when the challenge stays in onset; stagnation was never the ground of becoming.
archetype_tunings.The Witness: Courage in witnessing is staying without rushing to repair. The broadcast is space already held — quiet, steady hearing of what is here, meeting the telling rather than fearing the silence. Drive as Signal appears when presence itself is the onset; stagnation was never the ground of being heard.
archetype_tunings.The Catalyst: Courage for the Catalyst is the next concrete step already taking shape. The broadcast is motion without permission — intention turning into onset, attention on what to meet now. Drive returns as Signal the moment it becomes real that stagnation was never the ground.
